functions.name: financeiro_gestor_tem_acesso_fundo
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.financeiro_gestor_tem_acesso_fundo(p_fundo_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT private.gestor_tem_acesso_fundo_operacional(p_fundo_id);
$function$

functions.name: gestor_tem_acesso_fundo_operacional
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.gestor_tem_acesso_fundo_operacional(p_fundo_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    p_fundo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles p
      JOIN public.usuario_fundos uf
        ON uf.usuario_id = p.id
       AND uf.fundo_id = p_fundo_id
       AND uf.status = 'ativo'
      JOIN public.fundos f
        ON f.id = uf.fundo_id
       AND f.ativo
      WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid())
        AND p.status::text = 'ativo'
        AND (
          p.role::text = 'gestor'
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.usuario_papeis up
            WHERE up.usuario_id = p.id
              AND up.papel::text = 'gestor'
              AND up.ativo
          )
        )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.financeiro_auditar(p_tipo_evento text, p_importacao_id uuid, p_fundo_id uuid, p_correlation_id uuid, p_dados jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.plataforma_auditoria (
    tipo_evento, ator_usuario_id, origem, correlation_id, dados
  ) VALUES (

    (SELECT auth.uid()),
    'ingestao_financeira',

    jsonb_build_object(

$function$

functions.name: financeiro_autorizar_tecnico
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.financeiro_autorizar_tecnico()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT private.financeiro_chamada_service_role() AND NOT private.usuario_e_super_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501', MESSAGE = 'Acesso tecnico nao autorizado';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

functions.name: financeiro_fundo_virgem
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.financeiro_fundo_virgem(p_fundo_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT NOT (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.operacoes o
      JOIN public.cedente_fundos cf ON cf.id = o.cedente_fundo_id
      WHERE cf.fundo_id = p_fundo_id
        AND o.status IN ('em_andamento', 'inadimplente', 'liquidada')
        AND o.cessao_efetivada_em IS NOT NULL
    )
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.estoque_posicoes p WHERE p.fundo_id = p_fundo_id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aquisicao_movimentos m WHERE m.fundo_id = p_fundo_id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.liquidacao_movimentos m WHERE m.fundo_id = p_fundo_id)
  );
$function$

functions.name: usuario_e_super_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.usuario_e_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT (SELECT auth.uid()) IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles p
        JOIN public.usuario_papeis up ON up.usuario_id = p.id
       WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid())
         AND p.status::text = 'ativo'
         AND up.papel::text = 'super_admin'
         AND up.ativo IS TRUE
    );
$function$

constraints.name: nfse_calculated_net_evidence_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((valor_liquido_origem IS DISTINCT FROM 'CALCULADO_RETENCOES'::text) OR (((tipo_documento_fiscal = 'NFSE'::text) AND private.nfse_calculo_liquido_valido(valor_bruto, valor_liquido, (fiscal_proveniencia -> 'calculo_liquido'::text))) IS TRUE)))

constraints.name: nfse_fatos_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((tipo_documento_fiscal IS DISTINCT FROM 'NFSE'::text) OR (((valor_liquido_origem IS NOT NULL) AND (((valor_liquido_origem = ANY (ARRAY['DOCUMENTO_EXPLICITO'::text, 'CALCULADO_RETENCOES'::text])) AND (valor_liquido IS NOT NULL) AND (valor_liquido > (0)::numeric) AND (valor_liquido <= valor_bruto)) OR ((valor_liquido_origem = 'NAO_INFORMADO'::text) AND (valor_liquido IS NULL))) AND (vencimento_origem IS NOT NULL) AND (data_vencimento >= data_emissao) AND (fiscal_proveniencia IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(fiscal_proveniencia) = 'object'::text) AND (fiscal_proveniencia ?& ARRAY['strategy'::text, 'source'::text, 'competencia'::text, 'sha256'::text, 'vencimento_documento'::text]) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'sha256'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ((((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'strategy'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['danfse_v2_labels'::text, 'danfse_v2_visual'::text])) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'source'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['PDF_TEXT_NATIVE'::text, 'PDF_VISUAL_FALLBACK'::text])) AND (chave_acesso IS NOT NULL) AND (chave_acesso ~ '^[0-9]{50}$'::text) AND (chave_acesso !~ '^([0-9])\1{49}$'::text)) OR (((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'strategy'::text) = 'nfse_municipal_visual'::text) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'source'::text) = 'PDF_VISUAL_FALLBACK'::text) AND (chave_acesso IS NULL) AND (numero_nf ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,14}$'::text) AND (cnpj_emitente ~ '^[0-9]{14}$'::text) AND (cnpj_destinatario ~ '^[0-9]{14}$'::text) AND (valor_bruto > (0)::numeric) AND (fiscal_proveniencia ?& ARRAY['orgao_emissor'::text, 'codigo_verificacao'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((fiscal_proveniencia -> 'orgao_emissor'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text) ~ '^(PREFEITURA|MUNICIPIO|SECRETARIA)'::text) AND ((length((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text)) >= 8) AND (length((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text)) <= 200)) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text) = upper(btrim(regexp_replace((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text), '\s+'::text, ' '::text, 'g'::text)))) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'orgao_emissor'::text) !~ '[^A-Z0-9 /().,''-]'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((fiscal_proveniencia -> 'codigo_verificacao'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((fiscal_proveniencia ->> 'codigo_verificacao'::text) ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9./-]{3,79}$'::text)))) IS TRUE)))
